method.domOrder: lesson primer -> article body -> learning review
method.svg: Screen-space bounds of visible labels; nested KaTeX SVG excluded; fully off-screen geometry in a deliberate mobile viewBox crop is not partial clipping.
method.scenes: Stable outer modern figure canvas, with all scene buttons in targeted rechecks. Nested scroll content is not a separate frame.
method.mergeOrder: The targeted flex-final-recheck supersedes four HMR failures measured earlier during the still-running bulk flex-pattern-final run. Other result batches merge by completion time.
method.console: Application warnings, errors, page errors, failed requests recorded. Vite/HMR/devtools chatter separated. Recharts initial ResizeObserver -1 warning excluded only after four actual chart/SVG sizes were rechecked.
method.limitations: Chromium at two viewports; default article DOM on all routes. Scene controls were exercised when exposed via data-viz-controls and aria-pressed. Expanded shared lesson controls were checked on six representative routes. No exhaustive input-domain or cross-browser claim.

falsePositiveClasses: SVG getBBox before transforms can appear outside the viewBox although screen bounds fit.
Mobile scene-specific viewBox crops deliberately exclude unrelated geometry.
Nested scroll canvases move within the fixed outer frame; measuring them as independent frames misreports drift.
Dev HMR can detach an element and produce zero bounds or destroy the execution context; affected routes were rerun after registration writes stopped.

fixes.problem: Nested overflow containers made scene controls move or leave the viewport.
fixes.change: Use the outer canvas as the scrollport, remove the nested bottom gap, and keep expanded lesson controls anchored to that canvas. For the exact nested flex-1 scene-body pattern, keep both the inner scene and its content at natural height so diagrams and descriptions do not overlap controls.

fixes.problem: Fixed diagram nodes exceeded equal-width columns.
fixes.change: Give node columns more room than arrow columns and wrap long labels.

fixes.problem: Animated SVG circle cy became the string undefined.
fixes.change: Keep circle coordinates fixed and animate the enclosing group's translation.

fixes.problem: A diagram's last sentence was partly outside its SVG.
GPU diagram nodes or long labels exceeded the canvas by 5–25 px.
fixes.change: Allow columns to shrink within available space and wrap network detail labels.

fixes.problem: Long TCB identifiers enlarged a mobile grid to 412 px.
fixes.change: Use a zero-minimum single column and allow long identifiers to wrap.

fixes.problem: KaTeX had no metrics for the Unicode small-cap c used as a subscript.
fixes.change: Use A_c in the math term and spell out the product in the explanation.

fixes.problem: Flex shrink reduced mobile Recharts plots to 0 px and 47 px.
fixes.change: Let scene content keep its natural height and prevent the 234 px chart from shrinking; use the outer canvas for scrolling.

fixes.problem: Mafs boundary ticks and one bar-chart label were partly clipped.
fixes.change: Adjust plot/label margins while preserving values, formulas, and data.

fixes.problem: Long scene button labels occupied nearly the full mobile canvas height.
fixes.change: Keep the full explanation in the scene heading and use concise step names on the buttons.
